title: Livestock
description: Livestock catalogue entry: factual/reference characteristics of a breed (by species, gender, production type), independent of any specific animal, owner, or transactional event. Field set is kept identical to esLivestockRequiredFields.json: status is documented here as a server-managed, read-only property -- set by the service layer, never submitted by the client.

livestockId.description: System-generated primary identifier for this catalogue entry. Server-set; not submitted by the client.

breed.description: Breed of the livestock (e.g. Boran, Horro, Fogera, Afar, Somali Camel).

locationType.description: Agro-ecological zone the breed is adapted to; absent when not applicable.

gender.description: Gender this reference entry describes; absent when not applicable (e.g. Beehive).

productionType.description: Typical production purpose for this breed/gender combination; absent when not applicable.

bodyCondition.description: Typical/reference body condition score for this breed classification; absent when not applicable.

liveWeightKg.description: Typical/average mature live body weight for this breed and gender, in kilograms.

heightCm.description: Typical/average height at withers for this breed and gender, in centimeters.

coatColor.description: Predominant/standard coat, skin, or plumage color for this breed.

hornStatus.description: Typical horn presence/condition for this breed, where applicable.

averageMilkYieldLitersPerDay.description: Reference average daily milk yield in liters for this breed, where applicable.

averageEggProductionPerWeek.description: Reference average eggs produced per week for this breed, for poultry.

averageDailyWeightGainGrams.description: Reference average daily weight gain in grams for this breed, for meat/fattening purposes.

woolFiberYieldKg.description: Reference wool/fiber yield in kilograms per shearing cycle, where applicable.

honeyYieldKgPerHarvest.description: Reference honey yield in kilograms per harvest cycle, for beehives.

grazingSystem.description: Recommended management/grazing system for this breed.

status.description: Server-managed lifecycle status. Set by the service layer; not submitted by the client.
